invariants.title: Independent Khronos spirv-val Specification Validation
invariants.proposition: Every SPIR-V module emitted by src/part6_spirv.c passes external Khronos spirv-val (--target-env vulkan1.0); if spirv-val is unavailable, the gate resolves to BLOCKED and exits non-zero.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Missing spirv-val returns BLOCKED; invalid SPIR-V module returns FAIL.
invariants.verification_method: tools/verify_track21b_release.py + negative control with stripped PATH.

invariants.title: Deterministic SPIR-V Binary Generation & Compiler PASSES Isolation
invariants.proposition: Repeated invocations of src/part6_spirv.c / zcc-spirv on identical op parameters emit bitwise-identical .spv SHA-256 digests, while compiler PARTS and BOOTSTRAP_BASELINES.tsv remain unchanged.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Non-deterministic .spv SHA-256 or unintended mutation of part0..part6_ptx / BOOTSTRAP_BASELINES.tsv.
invariants.verification_method: Multi-pass .spv digest comparison + make selfhost md5 check.

invariants.title: Explicit Vulkan Memory Synchronization & Resource Lifetime
invariants.proposition: Every Vulkan compute execution brackets dispatch with HOST->COMPUTE and COMPUTE->HOST vkCmdPipelineBarrier transitions, uses VkFence completion, handles non-coherent flush/invalidate, destroys all Vulkan objects cleanly, and records zero VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation errors.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Validation layer error/warning, ASan/LSan leak, missing sync barrier count (< 2), or unclean teardown.

invariants.title: Honest Physical-Device Identity & Capability Negotiation
invariants.proposition: Vulkan capability probing explicitly classifies physical_device_type (e.g. CPU for Mesa llvmpipe, vendorID=0x10005), rejects ZCC_BACKEND_VULKAN_GPU on CPU-only ICDs under EXACT_REQUIRED, and rejects buffers/push-constants/accum modes exceeding device limits.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: CPU ICD labeled as DISCRETE_GPU/INTEGRATED_GPU or exceeding device limits without rejection.
invariants.verification_method: Device identity inspection + mocked restricted zcc_vulkan_caps_t tests.

invariants.title: Cross-Backend Numerical Equivalence (Scalar, AVX2, PTX, Vulkan SPIR-V)
invariants.proposition: All 13 operations executed on Vulkan SPIR-V (llvmpipe) match SCALAR_C99, AVX2_FMA, PTX_SM120, and an independent FP64 oracle across normal, prime/boundary, strided, unaligned, extreme-magnitude, and NaN/Inf inputs within declared Track 21B tolerances.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Tolerance violation, unexpected NaN/Inf clamp, or unaligned/strided corruption.

invariants.title: Defined Deterministic Replay on Vulkan Compute Backend
invariants.proposition: Re-executing identical deterministic inputs and op configurations on VULKAN_SPV yields bitwise-identical output_buffer_sha256 and spirv_module_sha256.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Divergent output SHA-256 across repeat runs.
invariants.verification_method: 3x replay verification across all 13 operations on llvmpipe.

invariants.title: Bounds, Overflow, Aliasing, OOM & Sanitizer Memory Safety
invariants.proposition: Track 21B dispatch & Vulkan host execution pass ASan+LSan+UBSan with zero memory errors or leaks across bounds, integer overflow, readonly outputs, aliasing, invalid shapes, and OOM fault injection.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Any ASan/LSan/UBSan error or leaked Vulkan allocation.

invariants.title: Track 21B Mutation Observatory Sensitivity & Unknown Preservation
invariants.proposition: Controlled mutants spanning malformed SPIR-V, shader math/quant corruption, fabricated GPU device identity, missing spirv-val evidence, capability limit bypass, altered baseline artifacts, and verifier bypass are detected and killed while novel anomalies remain UNKNOWN.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Any injected mutant survives or missing validator returns PASS.

invariants.title: Track 21B Receipt Integrity & Tamper Detection
invariants.proposition: track21b.receipt.v1 seals v1 base, spirv_module_sha256, Vulkan device metadata, barrier counts, and verification_status=UNVERIFIED_RUNTIME_ONLY via canonical SHA-256 + optional HMAC-SHA256.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Independent verifier accepts forged SPIR-V hash, spoofed device type, altered barrier count, or self-certified PASS.

invariants.title: Oracle Independence, Release Closure, Verifier Purity & Historical Preservation
invariants.proposition: Independent release verifier enforces external spirv-val + VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation presence, canonical staged manifest closure, protected baseline/Track21A immutability (S_before==S_after), and clean Track 21A + selfhost non-regression.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: Missing external oracle reports PASS; baseline or historical Track 21A evidence mutated.

invariants.title: Vulkan Resource Ownership & Init-Boundary Fault-Injection Non-Leak Invariants (ZIG-VK-LIFETIME-001..008)
invariants.proposition: Every Vulkan handle/allocation (ctx, dlopen lib, VkInstance, VkDebugUtilsMessengerEXT, VkDevice, VkDescriptorSetLayout, VkPipelineLayout, VkDescriptorPool, VkCommandPool, VkFence, staging buffers/memory/maps, VkShaderModule, VkPipeline) enforces R_live = R_acquired - R_released = 0, strict reverse DAG teardown order, pre-pipeline structural SPIR-V 1.0 GLCompute validation (OpCapability Shader + OpMemoryModel Logical + OpEntryPoint GLCompute "main" + balanced OpFunction..OpFunctionEnd), null-safe idempotent teardown, atomic staging-buffer replacement rollback, cached shader/pipeline fault rollback, 21-point boundary fault non-leak equivalence, and >=10x churn recovery.
invariants.fail_closed_condition: R_live != 0, teardown_seq_violations != 0, LSan leak detected under Lavapipe 25.2.8/26.0.8, entryless SPIR-V reaches vkCreateComputePipelines, or any fault boundary leaks or breaks subsequent recovery.
invariants.verification_method: tests/track21b/test_track21b_vulkan.c (test_vulkan_lifetime_and_fault_injection + Noble 25.2.8-.2/.5 + Host 26.0.8 + DZN) under UBSan, ASan+LSan, and O2.
